consumer_contract.digest_rule: SHA-256 over the complete object bytes exactly as serialized above

normalization.edge_multiplicity: One carrier row equals one source CloudEdge row. Exact projected tuple duplicates are intentional parallel directed edges when source identities differ by properties.
normalization.edge_order: ascending source_id, target_id, edge_type from the held Kuzu query
normalization.node_order: ascending node_id from the held Kuzu query
normalization.serialization: json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) followed by one LF byte

population.definition: Every edge-incident CloudNode in the pinned device-local Kuzu topology whose layer is not semctl, with every directed non-semctl CloudEdge row.

source.edge_query: MATCH (a:CloudNode)-[e:CloudEdge]->(b:CloudNode) WHERE a.layer <> 'semctl' AND b.layer <> 'semctl' RETURN a.node_id,b.node_id,e.edge_type ORDER BY a.node_id,b.node_id,e.edge_type
source.held_computation_input_digest_definition: sha256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON for {nodes: full ordered non-semctl node rows, edges: full ordered directed non-semctl edge rows}; this validates source equivalence and is not the carrier object's byte digest
source.node_query: MATCH (n:CloudNode) WHERE n.layer <> 'semctl' RETURN n.node_id,n.node_type,n.layer ORDER BY n.node_id
